prep_corrections: plan.draft.json topics (M02, M06, M08, M12, M13) all had populations of 0-2 studies built around the target's own keywords (prep.done warnings); rebuilt: M08 and M06 reuse published topic tables, M12 is a new topic over all ultrasound studies. M02 and M13 dropped as topics (M02 is the age label itself; the M13 therapy-tool claim is handled as an overreach).

topics.inclusion_rule: Include studies that infer a paralinguistic property of the speaker or utterance (affect or emotion, speaker identity, speaking mode, prosody, intonation or pitch) from a non-acoustic speech-production signal recorded while speaking (EMG, EMA, ultrasound, real-time MRI, electropalatography, strain sensors, ECoG or intracortical recordings). Boundary: acoustic-only and face-video audiovisual emotion recognition are excluded; facial EMG or EEG emotion recognition without speech production is excluded; F0 or prosody counts only when reported as an output; surveys are pattern matches only; versions of one study count once.
topics.metric: speaker-trait decoding accuracy / UAR or age error

topics.inclusion_rule: Include studies whose ledger lists ultrasound imaging as an input modality and classify, by full-text pattern (reference list removed), how the network integrates a sequence of ultrasound frames over time: 3D (spatiotemporal) convolution, a CNN followed by a recurrent layer, ConvLSTM, or Transformer/Conformer attention. Boundary: mentions in related work, reviews, theses and tasks other than speech output (contour tracking, image prediction, recognition) still count as pattern matches, an upper bound; ConvLSTM hits were classified by snippet; versions count once by key.
topics.metric: temporal integration design of ultrasound networks

topics.inclusion_rule: Include studies whose ledger lists ultrasound imaging as an input modality and classify by full-text pattern (reference list removed where the script detects it) whether evaluation holds out speakers (speaker-independent, unseen or held-out speakers, leave-one-speaker-out, cross-speaker) or trains and tests within the same speakers (speaker-dependent, single-speaker). Boundary: mentions in related work and reviews count as pattern matches (upper bound); a study counts under every split it reports; versions count once by key.
topics.metric: whether test speakers are disjoint from training speakers
